body.name: Size-sensitive orientation-realization handle
body.construction: Freeze a coordinate transcendence basis \(U\), select square residual-Jacobian subsystems blockwise by child vertex, encode their multihomogeneous Bezout coefficients as prescribed-indegree orientation counts, and determine exactly which counts are realized in the prime incidence algebra after localization at \(S_G=R_{\sigma}\setminus P_G\), with one original edge coordinate separating all finite branches; the output is a recurrence in \(n,k\), not a guessed exponent.
